Resource Profile: BiologicallyDerivedProduct: EE VRIS Embryo

Official URL: https://fhir.ee/vris/StructureDefinition/ee-vris-embryo Version: 0.1.0
Active as of 2026-09-25 Computable Name: EEVRISEmbryo

Profile for embryo. (ee Embrüo. Iga embrüo on omaette BDP-ressurss, mis kannab enda andmeid (arengupäev, parent-viited munarakule ja spermale). Füüsiline pakend (kõrs) on eraldi BDP-instants, mis kannab division-i ja säilitusandmeid (preservationState, temperatuur, sulatamine, taaskülmutamine). )

Usages:

  • Refer to this Profile: Observation: EE VRIS Embryo Lifecycle Counts, Procedure: EE VRIS Allocation, Procedure: EE VRIS Cryopreservation, Procedure: EE VRIS Destruction... Show 4 more, Procedure: EE VRIS Donation, Procedure: EE VRIS Embryo Transfer, Procedure: EE VRIS Preimplantation Genetic Testing and SupplyDelivery: EE VRIS Biological material movement
  • Examples for this Profile: BiologicallyDerivedProduct/embryo1-1, BiologicallyDerivedProduct/embryo1-2, BiologicallyDerivedProduct/embryo1, BiologicallyDerivedProduct/embryo2-1 and BiologicallyDerivedProduct/embryo2

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
vris-bdp-3 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Fresh material must have an expiration date (ee Värskel materjalil peab olema kehtivusaeg) property.where(type.coding.code='preservation-state').value.ofType(CodeableConcept).coding.code='fresh' implies expirationDate.exists()
vris-bdp-4 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Source material must record collection details (ee Lähtematerjalil peavad olema kogumisandmed) division.empty() implies collection.exists()
vris-embryo-2 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Instants on kas pakend (division) või üksikembrüo (extension[package]), mitte mõlemat korraga division.exists() xor extension('https://fhir.ee/vris/StructureDefinition/ee-vris-package').exists()
vris-embryo-4 warning BiologicallyDerivedProduct Üksikembrüol peavad olema nii munaraku- kui spermaviide extension('https://fhir.ee/vris/StructureDefinition/ee-vris-package').empty() or parent.count() >= 2
vris-embryo-5 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Pakendil ei tohi olla parent-viiteid; sisu viitab pakendile division.empty() or parent.empty()

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
vris-bdp-3 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Fresh material must have an expiration date (ee Värskel materjalil peab olema kehtivusaeg) property.where(type.coding.code='preservation-state').value.ofType(CodeableConcept).coding.code='fresh' implies expirationDate.exists()
vris-bdp-4 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Source material must record collection details (ee Lähtematerjalil peavad olema kogumisandmed) division.empty() implies collection.exists()
vris-embryo-2 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Instants on kas pakend (division) või üksikembrüo (extension[package]), mitte mõlemat korraga division.exists() xor extension('https://fhir.ee/vris/StructureDefinition/ee-vris-package').exists()
vris-embryo-4 warning BiologicallyDerivedProduct Üksikembrüol peavad olema nii munaraku- kui spermaviide extension('https://fhir.ee/vris/StructureDefinition/ee-vris-package').empty() or parent.count() >= 2
vris-embryo-5 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Pakendil ei tohi olla parent-viiteid; sisu viitab pakendile division.empty() or parent.empty()
